北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感有点热，湿度大，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and feels warm. Stay hydrated with high humidity!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 6级较大，体感略凉，别着凉了，注意防风。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Strong winds in Cixi make it feel cooler. Mind the wind and don't catch a cold!
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天湿热，记得多喝水，保持身体舒爽哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and humid. Stay hydrated and keep cool!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气闷热，体感 33℃，防暑降温，注意补充水分。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is hot and stuffy, feeling like 33℃. Stay cool and hydrated!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 33℃，湿度大，记得防晒多补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feeling like 33℃ with high humidity. Stay hydrated and protected!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力 6级较大，体感略凉，别着凉了，注意防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Strong winds in Hangzhou make it feel cooler. Mind the wind and don't catch a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨 100%湿度，记得带好雨具，出行注意安全哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain and 100% humidity. Don't forget your umbrella and stay safe!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 35℃，炎热注意防暑，多喝水！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feeling like 35℃. It's hot, so prevent heatstroke and drink water!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 35℃，高温炎热，注意防暑降温！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feeling like 35℃. It's very hot, so take precautions against heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天炎热，体感 34℃，紫外线强，注意防晒补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot, feeling like 34℃. Strong UV, mind sun protection and hydration!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感湿热，湿度大，记得多喝水，注意防暑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and muggy. With high humidity, stay hydrated and prevent heatstroke.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨风力 6级大，体感略凉，湿度高，注意防风保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has strong 6-level winds, feeling cooler with high humidity. Mind the wind and stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，微风习习，体感舒适，户外活动很棒哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and pleasant with a gentle breeze. Perfect for outdoor activities!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，气温凉爽，体感舒适，记得添减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and cool, feeling comfortable. Remember to layer your clothing!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力 5级，湿度大，体感舒适，海边注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with 5-level winds and high humidity, but feels comfortable. Mind the wind by the sea!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，风力 6级，能见度低，行车注意安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with 6-level winds and low visibility. Drive safely!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，湿度 94%，能见度低，开车请务必小心。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy with 94% humidity and low visibility. Please drive very carefully!
